text: Very interesting product. Working to incorporate into our cleaning mix.. The bamboo towels are indeed very sturdy. We bought them to cut down on the use of paper towels that come from trees.  I have one handy in the kitchen to clean up the counter tops. Have used it about 10x, rinsing it out thoroughly each time, sometimes with a little soap and water to make sure it is clean.  So that's only one bamboo towel used in place of at least 10 regular paper towels! There's much more life in this towel too. It should be able to get a least 50x use.

product_metadata.title: Bambooee Reusable Bamboo Towel ( Single roll, each roll comes with 20 sheets of Bamboee Towels)
features: AS SEEN ON SHARK TANK: Bambooee, h as seen on Shark Tank, is the original bamboo paper towel replacement product.
DURABLE, SUPER ABSORBENT & MACHINE WASHABLE: Bambooee is stronger, more absorbent and more durable than regular paper towels. And they are machine washable up to 100 times -

TIPS FOR STORAGE: When you first get your Bambooee roll, you can keep it on a regular paper towel holder. One roll comes with 20 11.5” x 11” sheets. After washing, simply keep them under the counter in a basket or even in a plastic bag dispenser that attaches to the inside of your cabinet door! If you only use a few at a time, you can just keep them in the top rack of your dishwasher, and then they’ll get washed regularly as well.

SAVE MONEY AND HcELP THE ENVIRONMENT: Using Bambooee reusable bamboo towels don't contribute to the 3000 tons of paper towel waste created every day, and will save you money because you won't be buying paper towels constantly.
GREAT HOLIDAY GIFT! Bambooee reusable bamboo towels are a simple and useful gift for your friends and family.
